f.title: Scope: unregistered investigational products and registered products used outside their registration
f.statement: The procedure covers investigational products not registered in Israel (drugs, medical devices, advanced therapies): products not yet registered, or registered products used differently from the registered use, for a new indication, or to obtain further information on the registered use, including treatment stages. Adverse events from medical procedures that are part of the trial plan, including procedures preceding administration, must also be reported.
f.topic: Scope of clinical trial safety reporting

‫או כאשר השימוש הוא להתוויה חדשה‪ ,‬או כאשר השימוש בו נועד לרכוש מידע נוסף על השימוש הרשום‪,‬‬

rows.quote_en: The procedure refers to investigational products not registered in the State of Israel (drugs, medical devices and advanced therapies). This means products not yet registered, or products that were registered but are used in a way different from the registered use, or where the use is for a new indication, or where the use is intended to obtain additional information on the registered use, including treatment stages. In addition, adverse events that occurred as a result of medical procedures forming part of the trial plan must be reported, including procedures preceding administration of the investigational product.

f.title: Registered products used per their registration report under Procedure 6 or to the device division
f.statement: Safety reports for products registered in Israel used in line with their registration go to the Risk Management and Drug Information Department under Procedure 6 (drugs, including advanced therapies), or to the medical devices division under its instructions.

f.title: Report adverse events from MoH approval (Form 7) until the last participant ends treatment
f.statement: Adverse events at each site must be reported from receipt of the Director's approval (Form 7) until the last participant recruited at the site finishes treatment with the investigational product, unless the protocol or sponsor procedures say otherwise; reporting is sometimes required before approval (Forms 6, 7 or 8) where the information affects participant safety.

f.statement: Authority delegated to another party does not relieve the party responsible under law; the delegator must ensure the delegate is trained (education, training and experience) and acts per the instructions.

f.title: Ensure SAE documentation; assess seriousness, causality and expectedness independently of the investigator
f.statement: The sponsor ensures adequate documentation of safety events to allow severity and causality assessment, assesses seriousness, causality to the investigational (or comparator) product and expectedness (nature, severity, frequency) independently of the reporting investigator, and documents its own and the investigator's conclusions, even where they disagree.

rows.quote_en: 5.2.1 Documentation and assessment. The sponsor shall ensure that appropriate documentation of safety events exists, including the information needed to assess the severity and causality of the adverse events. The sponsor shall assess the seriousness of the event, the causality of the possible relationship to the investigational product (or the comparator), and shall examine whether the event was expected (expected/anticipated) in its nature, severity and frequency based on the existing information. The sponsor's assessment shall be carried out independently of the conclusions of the reporting investigator. The sponsor shall document its conclusions and the investigator's conclusions, also in cases of disagreement.

rows.quote_en: 5.2.2 Reporting in case of death or a life-threatening event. 5.2.2.1 The (commercial) sponsor, receiving a report from the investigator on the case and any new relevant information through follow-up reports, shall assess the seriousness of the event, the possible relationship to the investigational product and whether the event is expected in its nature, severity and frequency based on the existing data. This document shall be sent to the investigator also before approval to conduct the study is received.

f.title: Send DHPCs and new literature safety information to investigators within 15 days
f.statement: A DHPC from the manufacturer or a recognised-country authority, or new literature information with safety implications (a ban, restriction or warning), is sent to the investigator within 15 days of receipt by the sponsor, with a safety summary and the required consent update, also before trial approval.

‫בספרות המקצועית הרפואית שיש לו השלכות על בטיחות של מוצר המחקר והשימוש בו בבני אדם‪ .‬הכוונה‬
‫למידע הכולל איסור‪ ,‬הגבלה או אזהרה שקשורה לבטיחות‪ .‬ההודעה תשלח בתוך ‪ 15‬ימים מקבלת המידע‬
‫אצל היזם‪ .‬יש לצרף סיכום המידע בנושא הבטיחות וכן העדכון הנדרש בטופס ההסכמה‪ .‬מידע זה ישלח‬
                                                 ‫לחוקר גם טרם קבלת אישור לביצוע המחקר‪.

rows.quote_en: 5.2.4.2 A notice to medical staff published by the manufacturer or a health authority in a recognised country, or new information published in the professional medical literature with implications for the safety of the investigational product and its use in humans. This means information including a ban, restriction or warning related to safety. The notice shall be sent within 15 days of receipt of the information by the sponsor. A summary of the safety information and the required update of the consent form must be attached. This information shall be sent to the investigator also before approval to conduct the study is received.

f.title: Send DSMB conclusions changing the protocol or stopping the trial to investigators within 15 days

f.title: Send new safety findings to investigators within 15 days
f.statement: New findings on trial conduct or product development that may affect participant safety (e.g. a significant animal finding such as carcinogenicity, lack of efficacy in a life-threatening disease) are sent within 15 days of the sponsor summarising the information, with a safety summary and the consent update, also before trial approval.

rows.deadline: Within 15 days of the sponsor summarising the information
rows.quote:
5.2.4.4‬ממצאים חדשים הקשורים לביצוע הניסוי או לפיתוח של מוצר המחקר‪ ,‬שעלולים להשפיע על‬
‫בטיחותם של המשתתפים בניסוי יישלחו בתוך ‪ 15‬ימים מיום סיכום המידע אצל היזם‪ .‬לדוגמה ממצא‬
‫בטיחות משמעותי בניסויים בבעלי‪-‬חיים שהסתיים זה עתה (כגון‪ :‬קרצינוגניות)‪ ,‬חוסר יעילות של מוצר‬
‫מחקר המשמש בטיפול במחלה מסכנת חיים‪ .‬יש לצרף סיכום המידע בנושא הבטיחות וכן העדכון הנדרש‬
                       ‫בטופס ההסכמה‪ .‬מידע זה יישלח לחוקר גם טרם קבלת אישור לביצוע המחקר‪.

rows.quote_en: 5.2.4.4 New findings related to the conduct of the trial or the development of the investigational product that may affect the safety of trial participants shall be sent within 15 days of the date the information was summarised by the sponsor. For example, a significant safety finding in an animal study just completed (such as carcinogenicity), lack of efficacy of an investigational product used to treat a life-threatening disease. A summary of the safety information and the required update of the consent form must be attached. This information shall be sent to the investigator also before approval to conduct the study is received.

f.title: Send recognised-authority decisions on trial continuation to investigators within 7 days
f.statement: A recognised-country regulator's decision in principle on continuing the trial for safety reasons (temporary or permanent stop, or resumption) is sent within 7 days of receipt by the sponsor.
